title_zh: NEWS IN 10 每日新聞英語｜11 月 16 日

stories.headline_en: Taiwan Passes New Laws to Expand Maternity and Childcare Leave
stories.headline_zh: 臺灣通過修法擴大產假與育兒補助福利

sentences.en: Taiwan passed new legal changes to support working parents across the country.
sentences.zh: 臺灣通過了新的法律修正案，以支持全臺的有職家長。

sentences.en: The government hopes these friendly policies will help fix the declining birthrate.
sentences.zh: 政府希望這些友善政策能協助改善持續下降的出生率。

sentences.en: Employees will receive longer parental leave and higher financial subsidies from next year.
sentences.zh: 勞工從明年起將獲得更長的育嬰假與更高的經濟補助。

sentences.en: Parents can also divide their leave hours more easily to care for newborn children.
sentences.zh: 家長也可以更靈活地分配請假時數來照顧剛出生的孩子。

stories.headline_en: Exam Candidate Confesses to Using Generative AI to Cheat
stories.headline_zh: 韓國考生坦承利用生成式 AI 於國家考試作弊

sentences.en: A top scorer on a national exam in South Korea admitted to cheating.
sentences.zh: 一名在韓國國家考試中獲得最高分的考生公開承認作弊。

sentences.en: He took photos of the test papers with a tiny hidden camera.
sentences.zh: 他用針孔微型相機拍下了試卷上的題目照片。

sentences.en: The man sent images to generative AI models and read answers on his smartphone.
sentences.zh: 該男子將照片傳送至生成式 AI 模型，並在智慧型手機上讀取答案。

sentences.en: Officials promised to inspect test rooms carefully to prevent unfair behavior.
sentences.zh: 主考官員承諾將仔細檢查考場，以防止不公平的行為發生。

stories.headline_en: Singapore Retirees Explore Slow Travel Across Eight Cities
stories.headline_zh: 新加坡退休夫妻規劃慢活旅遊走訪八座城市

sentences.en: A retired couple from Singapore shared their inspiring story of slow travel.
sentences.zh: 一對來自新加坡的退休夫妻分享了他們令人啟發的慢活旅遊故事。

sentences.en: They stayed in eight foreign cities this year with a reasonable monthly budget.
sentences.zh: 他們今年以合理的每月預算，悠閒旅居了八個海外城市。

sentences.en: Instead of rushing between sights, they enjoyed cooking local food at rented houses.
sentences.zh: 他們不再於景點間匆忙奔波，而是在承租的寓所親自烹煮當地食材。

sentences.en: Many modern travelers now prefer deeper cultural immersion over crowded tours.
sentences.zh: 許多現代旅客如今更偏好深度的文化體驗，而非擁擠的走馬看花行程。
